title: Purpose of deposit.
bodyText: Each deposit shall be held by the director of finance in trust for the protection of all policyholders, obligees, or creditors in the United States of the insurer making it.
bodyHtml: §431:7-302  Purpose of deposit.  Each deposit shall be held by the director of finance in trust for the protection of all policyholders, obligees, or creditors in the United States of the insurer making it. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
